text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: After so much support from everyone and all the work you put into training me, I really wanted to live up to your expectations…
choice_data_list: The important thing is that you keep challenging yourself.
Then, let's see it in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Even though I'm never able to clinch victory, everyone still supports me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's why I can't give up! I have to push on and come in first next time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh! You're already thinking about what comes next for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That means I have to keep moving forward! I'll win next time and meet everyone's expectations!
